title: Grain Accounting Bulletin: What the Delayed Price Carry Comes To on Grain Marketing Contracts
content:
The delayed price carry charge on Grain Marketing Contracts is the monthly carry rate times the net bushels the parcel carries times the chargeable months, taken at the member's patron factor, and where that comes to less than the parcel minimum the parcel minimum is charged instead.

**The count of days.** The carry on a parcel is counted in calendar days from the carry anchor through to the day the parcel was priced, the anchor day itself counting as day zero, the free days allowed to the member are taken off that count, and what is left is grouped into chargeable thirty-day months. A part month left over at the end counts as a whole chargeable month.

**More than one parcel.** Where more than one parcel has stood unpriced on the contract, the carry is worked out on the bushels those parcels carry together, counted from the day the latest of them entered the member's unpriced position, and one parcel minimum is taken on the whole of it.

**The four figures that enter it.** The carry anchor is the day the parcel entered the member's unpriced position. The free days allowed are the free days the member's marketing programme carries. The monthly carry rate is the rate the member's marketing programme carries, and the parcel minimum and the patron factor are the programme's parcel minimum and a factor of one.

**Rounding.** The charge is rounded to the cent only once, on the figure reached after the rate, the bushels, the patron factor and the months have been multiplied together.

## Worked through on hypothetical figures

Take two parcels on one contract, of 1,500 and 2,500 net bushels, the later of them taking its place in the member's unpriced position on a day we shall call the anchor day. Both were priced on the one hundred and fourth day after that anchor day, the anchor day counting as day zero. Assume a hypothetical monthly carry rate of 0.06, a hypothetical free period of 12 days and a hypothetical parcel minimum of 30.00.

| Step | Hypothetical figure |
|---|---|
| Bushels the parcels carry together | 4,000.00 |
| Carry counted from the anchor day to the day of pricing | 104 days |
| Free days taken off | 12 days |
| Chargeable days | 92 days |
| Chargeable months, three whole months and a part month counting as a whole one | 4 |
| Rate times bushels times months, at a patron factor of one | 960.00 |
| One parcel minimum on the whole of it | 30.00 |

The charge is 960.00, the greater of the two figures, rounded to the cent once at that point.
